summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the Officina Lavori web app, which runs against the mobile app's live backend (job-sheet-hub-2). All requested flows work at 1920px: login (wrong-password error and success), logout, protected-route redirect, Home stats/folders/search, Customer page, Sheet page (summary, 6 phases plus toggles, DATI SCHEDA, labels and report PDFs both return 200 application/pdf, cutting navigation), Phase filter chips and step rows, Step page (timer-card, sessions-list, FOTO, COMPILAZIONE, action bar showing done/reopen for a completed step), Cutting page (summary, 22 rows table, 22 patterns), Scraps (filters, customer chips, empty-form validation toast, create TEST_MAT, detail /scrap/:id, delete), Operators (users-list, logo-settings, create and delete TEST_User), Excel upload (modal, file input, prefilled title, import), and Scan (garbage code toast, unknown sheet toast, valid OFFLAV|POS code opens the phase chooser). The one real bug: at 390px mobile width, /phase, /scraps and /operators scroll sideways.

minor.issue: A random .xlsx with no curvature table is accepted. It creates a sheet under 'SENZA CLIENTE' with one phase called 'SHEET' and 1 step, instead of being rejected. This is the mobile backend's behaviour, not the web app's, but users can create junk sheets by mistake.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the page scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 539 vs 390). The step rows stretch to 539px because the single-column grid has no explicit column template, so the long nowrap/truncate text sets the column width.

ui_bugs.component: Scraps page (Scraps.jsx line 133 and the PageHeader right slot)
ui_bugs.issue: At 390px the page scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 540). The scrap-section panel overflows for the same grid reason, and the header button group (settings + ETICHETTE QR + AGGIUNGI) uses shrink-0, so it overflows to 408px.
At 390px the page scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 497). users-list and logo-settings overflow because the grid's implicit auto column is sized to the long email text.

issues: In the DATI CURVATURA 2-column grid, numbers break mid-value (e.g. '38.' / '1', '500' / '0') and labels are cut off. Use 1 column on mobile or add whitespace-nowrap to values.

design_issues.screen: Opening a deleted or non-existent sheet (/sheet/:id returning 404)
issues: It stays on 'CARICAMENTO...' for about 7s because react-query's default retry (3x) also retries 404s. Set retry so it does not retry 4xx errors (index.js QueryClient).
The top-center sonner toast covers the central nav links in the top bar for a few seconds after each action (minor).

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow at mobile width: add 'grid-cols-1' to the base grids in Phase.jsx:80, Scraps.jsx:133 and Operators.jsx:54 (and, as a precaution, Customer.jsx:39, Home.jsx:121/130, Cutting.jsx:114, Sheet.jsx:134, Step.jsx:137, Scan.jsx:77, Scrap.jsx:23), or add min-w-0 to the grid children.
In ui.jsx PageHeader, remove 'shrink-0' from the right-hand button container (or let it wrap / go full width on mobile) so the 3 buttons on the Scraps header don't overflow at 390px.
Step.jsx DATI CURVATURA: use 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' so values don't break mid-number on mobile.
index.js QueryClient: set retry: (count, err) => !/^Errore 4|non trovat/i.test(err.message) && count < 2 (or similar) so 404s show the error at once.
critical_code_review_comments: The JWT is passed as ?token= in PDF/file/logo URLs (labelsUrl, reportUrl, fileUrl). The backend requires this for window.open, but the token ends up in browser history and server logs. Acceptable for an internal tool; consider short-lived signed URLs.
Scan.jsx Camera_ creates new window.BarcodeDetector without a try/catch; it is guarded by canScan, so this is fine.

UploadModal: when the import creates 0 sheets it shows toast.error ('Nessuna nuova scheda'), which is OK. When it creates 1 sheet it navigates straight to that sheet, but no success toast was seen in the test (it was likely already gone after the 6s wait). Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (every requested flow works; mobile overflow on 3 of 10 pages)
